question: Why does Pi report 'MCP HTTP request failed with status 405' at http://127.0.0.1:3020/mcp?
probes: Curl GET and POST /mcp on the live port-3020 server and read its allow header
Inspect the listening process, its start time and whether its executable was replaced
Read Pi's streamable-HTTP transport to see which method tolerates 405
resolution: FIXED THIS TURN: the stale process on port 3020 was replaced by a fresh start of the current binary, and data/mcp.json was written with enabled=true and the exact bearer token already present in Pi's ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json. Verified by curl: POST /mcp now returns 200 JSON-RPC for initialize, tools/list (all 6 tools) and tools/call; a wrong token returns 401; /api/health returns ok. GET /mcp still returns 405 by design and is tolerated. No source change was needed — the route was already correct.
